title: Incorrect SMS bolus delivered. 3.0.0.1 dev-i
body:
Incorrect SMS bolus delivered (17.48 )
Instead of 4.0IE, 0.2IE was given.
The wrong IOB was also displayed on the NS client, it was correct on the master.

Pixel 4a/Omnipod Dash/Build 391a471b2

THX. Greetings.
